name: pdftk
description: Classic PDF toolkit for merging, splitting, rotating, form filling, and watermarking operations

pdftk.description: Classic PDF toolkit for comprehensive document manipulation, form processing, and security operations
pdftk.usage:
pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf # Merge multiple PDF files
pdftk input.pdf cat 1-5 output pages1to5.pdf # Extract pages 1-5
pdftk input.pdf cat 1-endodd output odd_pages.pdf # Extract odd pages only
pdftk input.pdf rotate 1-endright output rotated.pdf # Rotate all pages 90° clockwise
pdftk form.pdf fill_form data.fdf output filled.pdf # Fill PDF form with FDF data
pdftk input.pdf stamp watermark.pdf output stamped.pdf # Add watermark to all pages
pdftk input.pdf burst # Split into individual pages (pg_0001.pdf, etc.)
pdftk input.pdf dump_data output metadata.txt # Extract PDF metadata
pdftk input.pdf update_info metadata.txt output updated.pdf # Update PDF metadata
pdftk secured.pdf input_pw password cat output unlocked.pdf # Remove password protection
